stem: A nurse is monitoring pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP/PCWP) through a pulmonary artery catheter. What does this measurement primarily estimate?

options.A: Left atrial pressure and left-sided ventricular filling pressure when the wedge tracing is obtained and interpreted correctly.
options.B: Right atrial pressure and systemic venous filling pressure measured directly from the proximal pulmonary-artery catheter lumen.
options.C: Arterial oxygen saturation and oxygen-delivery adequacy derived directly from the pressure generated by balloon occlusion.
options.D: Glomerular filtration and renal perfusion estimated from the pulmonary-artery pressure waveform during catheter balloon inflation.

rationale: StatPearls/NCBI states that PCWP is frequently used to assess left-ventricular filling and represent left-atrial pressure. When the balloon occludes a pulmonary-artery branch, the resulting static blood column provides a pressure that indirectly estimates left-atrial pressure; in most cases it also estimates LV end-diastolic pressure. Accurate waveform acquisition and interpretation remain essential. A is correct. B describes a separate right-atrial measurement, C confuses pressure with oxygen-saturation measurements, and D assigns a renal function that PAWP does not measure.
educational_objective: Interpret PAWP/PCWP as an indirect estimate of left atrial and left-sided ventricular filling pressure when correctly obtained.
source_organization: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI Bookshelf) / StatPearls
source_version_date: StatPearls 2026 edition; last update April 17, 2023; live NCBI page retrieved 2026-08-26
source_locator: Continuing Education Activity/Introduction: PCWP assesses LV filling and represents LA pressure. Anatomy and Physiology: in most cases estimates LVEDP. Technique: wedging creates a static blood column and an indirect estimate of LA pressure. Clinical Significance: reasonable surrogate of LA pressure and LVEDP; accurate tracing interpretation required.
source_claim_supported: PAWP/PCWP indirectly estimates left atrial pressure and commonly left ventricular filling/LVEDP when properly measured.
blueprint_locator: Reduction of Risk Potential — invasive hemodynamic monitoring and interpretation.
correction_summary: Removed 'only' cueing, balanced all options, and added the measurement-quality qualification needed for PAWP interpretation.

audit_findings.independent_adversarial_second_pass: PASS — NCBI directly identifies LA pressure/LV filling as the physiologic estimate; the other choices measure different domains.
